svg.title: LLMSlim: The context layer for production AI agents.
svg.desc: Compress, plan and budget what the model sees, from prompts and chat history to RAG chunks, tool schemas and agent memory. It runs inside your own process: no API key, no network call. 212× lower cost than Mem0 (LongMemEval); 42× lower cost, same accuracy (vs full history); 3× fewer tokens, same score (LongBench v1); +21 points over LLMLingua-2 (NaturalQuestions). Backed by OpenAI, Claude, MongoDB, Sarvam, Zoho, Auth0, Zendesk, Mixpanel, Sentry, Descope, Pulumi, Honeycomb, Exa, Neo4j, Cartesia.
